summary.text: Vanessa Sheehan is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 43, where she assumed office on December 7, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A realtor from Milford, she is vice chair of the Legislative Administration Committee.

paragraphs.text: Vanessa Sheehan was born in Milford, New Hampshire, where she lives, and earned an associate degree in communications.
Her career experience includes working as a realtor.
Sheehan was assigned to the Legislative Administration Committee as clerk in 2021-2022 and as vice chair in 2023-2024.
